cited_by.title: Rashes on dark skin: what to look for

record.population: Published literature on allergic skin conditions in people with skin of colour
record.finding: Allergic skin conditions affect all backgrounds, but the authors say the way redness (erythema) is assessed and how patch tests are read need extra care in skin of colour.
record.note: Abstract read only; says redness assessment is a nuance but gives no figures.
